sources.title: Holistic Evaluation of Language Models (HELM) - Stanford University
sources.snippet: The Holistic Evaluation of Language Models (HELM) serves as a living benchmark for transparency in language models. Providing broad coverage and recognizing incompleteness, multi-metric measurements, and standardization. All data and analysis are freely accessible on the website for exploration and study.
